# Fernando Ghiberti

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer — React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript. Personal portfolio with live GitHub activity, an AI-powered "Ask Fernando" chat assistant, and a project showcase.

Based in Vinhedo, São Paulo, Brazil. 8+ years building scalable web applications, leading front-end architecture, design systems, and engineering teams.

## Projects

- [AI Code Reviewer](https://github.com/ghiberti85/ai-code-reviewer): AI-powered static code analysis tool (React, TypeScript, Groq).
- [DevInterviewLab](https://github.com/ghiberti85/devinterviewlab): AI-assisted technical interview practice platform (Next.js, Supabase, Groq).
- [Interview Command Center](https://github.com/ghiberti85/interview-command-center): Interview preparation dashboard (React, Vite, Claude AI).
- [Ghiberti UI](https://github.com/ghiberti85/ui): Open-source design-system monorepo (Turborepo, Storybook, Radix UI).
- [Finanças do Casal](https://github.com/ghiberti85/financa-casal): Couples finance tracker with JWT-secured row-level security (React, Vite, Supabase).
- [Philosophia](https://github.com/ghiberti85/philosophia): Bilingual PWA (Next.js, i18n, DALL-E).
